meta.title: Format — Layer2D
meta.description: The open .l2d avatar container format, layer2d/v1.
format.title: The .l2d format
format.bundle.heading: Bundle
format.bundle.introHtml: An .l2d file is a standard ZIP archive. Format identifier: layer2d/v1. JSON members are deflated; textures are stored uncompressed so the runtime can read them directly.
format.bundle.c3: layer textures, eye masks, expression pieces
format.bundle.requiredHtml: Required: layer2d.json, pack.json, SHA256SUMS.json, and every texture referenced by pack.json. Absolute paths, .. segments and duplicate entries are rejected.
format.manifest.heading: Manifest
format.manifest.introHtml: layer2d.json describes the avatar without parsing the runtime pack.
format.manifest.rowLicense: License identifier or summary for the artwork and rig.
format.manifest.rowCanvas: Source canvas size in pixels. All mesh coordinates use this space.
format.pack.heading: Runtime pack
format.pack.introHtml: pack.json holds everything the player draws and animates. Each entry in layers references tex/<id>.<texExt>; optional per-layer variants add companion textures.
format.pack.rowLayersHtml: Ordered draw list: mesh, depth, warp grid, toggles. Variants: _sheer, _hole, _up, _palm, _posed, _wipe, _open.
format.pack.rowChains: Spring chains for hair locks, ears, tail, ribbons and tassels.
format.physics.heading: Depth & physics
format.physics.p1: Hair is split into stacked strata — back, back sides, scalp cap, bangs, sides — each with a signed depth. Back hair carries negative depth, so head turns produce true parallax instead of crossfades. Hair opacity never fades during a turn.
format.physics.p2: Spring chains are multi-joint and solved per frame in the runtime, independent of frame rate.
format.integrity.heading: Integrity
format.integrity.p1Html: SHA256SUMS.json maps every member except itself to its SHA-256 hex digest. A valid bundle has an exact key match, matching digests, all referenced textures present, and manifest stats equal to the pack.
format.license.heading: License
format.license.p1Html: The layer2d/v1 specification is open and royalty-free. Anyone may read, write and ship .l2d files without fees. Each avatar declares its own artwork license in the manifest.
